description: Secure attended ChatGPT Pro handoffs with an experimental read-only Web MCP runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Approved Pro handoffs, response monitoring, and Web MCP
interface.longDescription: Prepare approved immutable repository consultations for logged-in ChatGPT Pro using GitHub-first text handoffs or an explicitly selected experimental read-only Web MCP session. Schema 4 exposes seven bounded read-only research tools and separately approved Codex context notes; Pro returns advice in visible Chat. The MCP path binds one package to a foreground official Secure MCP Tunnel client, private local authorization state, and a fail-before-return disclosure audit; account and Developer Mode steps remain attended.

Use $gptpro for an attended read-only Web MCP review after package-specific approval.
